rows.quote: Associations of the cis-pQTL variants with prostate cancer were studied in summary-level statistics of genome-wide association studies (GWASs) from the Prostate Cancer Association Group to Investigate Cancer Associated Alterations in the Genome (PRACTICAL) consortium and FinnGen Release 8 [16, 17].
rows.coder_note: Rule I2: the sentence, given under the PRACTICAL row, names this row's dataset as FinnGen Release 8 (rule A: release 8 = R8); this row's own passages give no release and none conflicts.

rows.quote: [Table 1. Detailed information of data sources of the included GWAS studies. GWAS, genome-wide association studies] Traits: Prostate cancer | MR-base ID: ieu-b-85 | Consortium: PRACTICAL | Cases: 79,148 | Control: 61,106 | Sample size: 140,254 | Year: 2018 | Population: European | Pubmed ID: 29,892,016 | Website: http://practical.icr.ac.uk/blog/?page_id=8164
rows.coder_note: Rules B and G: the table names the dataset by the OpenGWAS accession ieu-b-85, which no dictionary row lists; the prose cites reference 16 (Schumacher 2018, DOI of the PRACTICAL/ELLIPSE row) with 79,148 cases and 61,106 controls, which are not that row's 79,194 and 61,112.
